fields.name: save_slot
fields.meaning: The one save slot (2 KB). Saving copies the whole working copy at 0x0800-0x0FFF here; loading copies 0x0000-0x06EB back. The rows below are offsets inside this slot; the same layout applies to the working copy at +0x800
fields.evidence: code 4000:07C6 (save: copy 0x400 words 0x0800->0x0000), 4000:07AA (load: copy 0x376 words 0x0000->0x0800); only slot bytes change when saving

fields.name: event_flags
fields.meaning: Story/event flags, one bit each: flag n is bit (n mod 8) of byte n/8. The title screen tests flag 0x1D1 (byte 0x3A) in the saved slot; a new game starts with bytes 0x30-0x4A, 0x60, 0x80, 0xA0 already set
fields.evidence: code 4000:08C4 (live copy, base 0x0800), 4000:08B0 (saved slot, base 0x0000); power-on read of 0x003A by the title screen; bytes 0x00 and 0x20 gain bits during the first scenes; new-game ROM template. End of the area (0xBF) inferred from the next field

fields.name: playtime_ticks
fields.meaning: Play time, fraction of a second: counts 0-75 once per screen refresh (76 per second)
fields.evidence: code 4000:01AB (refresh interrupt, wraps at 76); advances between saves

fields.name: playtime_seconds
fields.meaning: Play time seconds 0-59 (6 in the save, shown 00:02:06)
fields.evidence: code 4000:01AB carry; load box shows 00:02:06

fields.name: playtime_minutes
fields.meaning: Play time minutes 0-59
fields.evidence: code 4000:01AB carry; load box

fields.name: playtime_hours
fields.meaning: Play time hours, freezes at 99:59:59
fields.evidence: code 4000:01AB (cap 99)

fields.name: reserved_00c4
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every recorded save and no code references it
fields.evidence: always 0; xref search found no readers/writers

fields.name: map
fields.meaning: Map the player is on (0x1B in the save). The load box turns it into the place name shown as the save location (here Yamato plaza)
fields.evidence: code 4000:BEBC writes it at save time, 5000:7E8A restores it on load, 5000:8062 looks the place name up in a ROM table; 0x00->0x1B at the first save

fields.name: player_x
fields.meaning: Player position across the map, in pixels (sprite X + 4)
fields.evidence: code 4000:BEA4-BEC5, 5000:7E93 restores it; changed after walking between saves

fields.name: player_y
fields.meaning: Player position down the map, in pixels (sprite Y + 8)
fields.evidence: code 4000:BEAE-BECE, 5000:7E9C restores it; changed after walking

fields.name: player_pose
fields.meaning: Player facing/animation value, copied from the player sprite
fields.evidence: code 4000:BE9D/BED7 (sprite word +0x0E), 5000:7EA5 restores it; changed with the facing

fields.name: map_characters
fields.meaning: Other characters on the current map: 15 entries of 8 bytes (X, Y, facing/animation, state word), so people stand where they were when the game is loaded
fields.evidence: code 4000:BEDC-BF08 (save from the 15 sprite slots), 4000:BF0B (restore); entries change between saves

fields.name: reserved_014c
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every recorded save and no code references it
fields.evidence: always 0; xref search found no readers/writers

fields.name: player_name
fields.meaning: Player name, 6 characters in the game's kana code (hiragana 0x01=あ..0x2E=ん, katakana 0x38=ア..0x65=ン, small kana, voiced rows, 0xC7=ー, 0xFF=blank). Save: ゼンああきき, shown on the load box
fields.evidence: entry overwrites these bytes; load box renders them; code values verified against dozens of ROM item/dish/move names

fields.name: unk_015a
fields.meaning: A map-setup selector picked from a ROM table when the player is placed (1 in the save); exact purpose unknown
fields.evidence: code 4000:0F65 (write), 4000:B711/B7C4 (read as an index into a setup table)

fields.name: item_kinds
fields.meaning: How many different items are held (max 40)
fields.evidence: code (add/remove); value 4 matches 4 used entries and 4 rows on the item screen

fields.name: items
fields.meaning: Item list, 40 entries of 2 bytes: item number, count (up to 4). Numbers are 1-based indexes into the ROM name table (15=egg, 53=rice, 62=ketchup, 67=salt here, matching the 4 rows on the item screen)
fields.evidence: code 4000:06F7 (lists entries whose count is nonzero); ROM name table order matches id and screen order

fields.name: blank_cards
fields.meaning: Blank cards held (5 in the save, as shown in the field menu). One is spent when a new Foodon joins
fields.evidence: code 4000:1380 (set/add), 4000:9783 (-1 on join); field menu shows 5

fields.name: foodon_count
fields.meaning: Number of Foodon (cooking monsters) with the player; shown on the load box (2)
fields.evidence: code 5000:8084 (load box), 4000:977F (+1 on join); load box shows 2

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Cash held (0 in the save, shown as 0 in the field menu), capped at 9999
fields.evidence: code 4000:0BB0 (give, cap 9999), 4000:0BD7 (take, refuses overdrafts); field menu shows it

fields.name: id_number
fields.meaning: Number minted when a new game starts and copied into +0x08 of the starting Foodon records; 0 in this save
fields.evidence: code 4000:0190-01A3 (new game)

fields.name: collection
fields.meaning: Sorted list of up to 50 entry numbers (1-63), one byte each, 0 = empty; 1 entry (number 1) from the start. What the entries stand for is unknown
fields.evidence: code 4000:1147 (add if free slot, sort), 4000:0749 (list)

fields.name: reserved_01e4
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in this save but compared against battle scratch memory by code
fields.evidence: code 4000:F415/F509/E416 (battle-time compares)

fields.name: foodon_party
fields.meaning: Foodon records, 15 of 0x20 bytes; a record is in use when byte +0x10 is not 0. Rows below give the record layout
fields.evidence: code 4000:9762-977A (join: first free record, copy 0x20 bytes); load box; status screen

fields.name: foodon.cook
fields.meaning: +0x00 Name of the cook who made this Foodon: the player's name, 0xFF-padded to 8
fields.evidence: name entry writes it into the starting records too; status screen shows it

fields.name: foodon.id
fields.meaning: +0x08 Copy of the per-game number at 0x01B0

fields.name: foodon.name
fields.meaning: +0x0A Foodon name, 6 characters (record 1: オムレッサー, record 2: チャーマン)
fields.evidence: status screen matches the bytes

fields.name: foodon.kind
fields.meaning: +0x10 Foodon kind number (2 and 1 here); 0 = record empty

fields.name: foodon.unk_11
fields.meaning: +0x11 unknown (0)

fields.name: foodon.fp
fields.meaning: +0x12 FP (60 in both records; status screen FP 60)
fields.evidence: status screen

fields.name: foodon.moves
fields.meaning: +0x14..+0x16 Move ids, three slots, 0 = empty (record 1: move 6 only; the move screen shows that move plus two blank rows). Id 6 is the 6th ROM move name
fields.evidence: move screen row count matches; ROM move-name table order

fields.name: foodon.evade
fields.meaning: +0x17 evade stat (43)
fields.evidence: status screen

fields.name: foodon.luck
fields.meaning: +0x18 luck stat (51)
fields.evidence: status screen

fields.name: foodon.defence
fields.meaning: +0x19 defence stat (22)
fields.evidence: status screen

fields.name: foodon.level
fields.meaning: +0x1A Level (1)
fields.evidence: status screen LV 1

fields.name: foodon.unk_1b
fields.meaning: +0x1B..+0x1F unknown (differs per record; experience and flavour fields are probably here)

fields.name: foodon_kept
fields.meaning: A second list of 25 Foodon records (same layout); the load box shows how many are in use in brackets after the Foodon count (0 in the save)
fields.evidence: code 5000:8096-80B7 (count records with +0x10 not 0); load box shows (0)

fields.name: format_mark
fields.meaning: Format mark: 137 words counting up 0, 1, 2 ... 0x88. A save is accepted only if this pattern is present and the check word matches (blank memory passes the sum but fails the mark)
fields.evidence: code 4000:07D4 (written at save), 4000:078B (checked at load); present in every save, absent before the first

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Check word: 16-bit sum of the 1023 words at 0x0000-0x07FD
fields.evidence: code 4000:07E6-07F7 (computed at save), 4000:076F-0789 (checked at load); recomputed on every recorded save

fields.name: working_copy
fields.meaning: The game keeps its current state here (same layout as the slot) and changes it while playing; it is not the save. A new game fills it from a ROM template; loading copies the slot here
fields.evidence: code 4000:0156 (new game: clear, copy 0x24C bytes from ROM 5000:9040), 4000:07AA (load); template equals ROM bytes; play time ticks here between saves

fields.name: work_memory
fields.meaning: Scratch memory (for example list building at 0x1800); not part of the save
fields.evidence: code 4000:06F7, 4000:1188 (temporary lists at 0x1800); outside the checked range

fields.name: not_used
fields.meaning: The console's own memory is not changed by saving
fields.evidence: byte-identical before and after saving
